events.name: Joshua P. B. Eddy licensed to preach in the African Methodist Episcopal Church
events.description: On May 22, 1822, Richard Allen signed a printed certificate licensing Joshua P. B. Eddy to preach in the African Methodist Episcopal Church, on behalf of the Quarterly Conference. || The certificate, a printed form filled in by hand: 'Philadelphia, May 22nd 1822. This is to Certify, That the bearer, Joshua P B Eddy is licensed to preach in the African Methodist Episcopal Church. Signed in behalf of the Quarterly Conference of said Church, so long as his life corresponds with the Gospel, to be renewed once a year, and he submit to the rules of the Discipline of said Church. Given under my hand, this 22nd day of May in the year of our Lord one thousand eight hundred and twenty two. Richard Allen, Minister.' Printed at the foot: 'J. H. Cunningham, printer, No. 70, S. Third-street, Philadelphia.' The last figure of the year and the written year are faint on the original; 1822 agrees with Julie Winch's note that Eddy was licensed to preach in 1822. Source: Historical Society of Pennsylvania, Leon and Beatrice Gardiner collection. Photograph of the original: clippings/HSP_1822-05-22_joshua-p-b-eddy-license-to-preach.jpg
